using System;
using System.Windows.Forms;

private void btnLaserEnableDisable_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
{
    
    //IL_0173: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
    try
    {
        if (cb_sweep.Checked)
        {
            if (((Control)btnLaserEnableDisable).Text == "Enable Laser")
            {
                ushort regData = 0;
                hostComm.WriteRegister(39, regData);
                ((Control)btnLaserEnableDisable).Text = "Disable Laser";
                hostComm.WriteRegister(16, Convert.ToUInt16(40959));
                regData = 3840;
                hostComm.WriteRegister(39, regData);
            }
            else
            {
                ((Control)btnLaserEnableDisable).Text = "Enable Laser";
                ushort regData = 0;
                hostComm.WriteRegister(39, regData);
                hostComm.WriteRegister(16, Convert.ToUInt16(0));
            }
        }
        else if (((Control)btnLaserEnableDisable).Text == "Enable Laser")
        {
            ((Control)btnLaserEnableDisable).Text = "Disable Laser";
            ushort regData2 = Convert.ToUInt16(((Control)nud_Index).Text);
            hostComm.WriteRegister(21, regData2);
            hostComm.WriteRegister(16, Convert.ToUInt16(40959));
        }
        else
        {
            ((Control)btnLaserEnableDisable).Text = "Enable Laser";
            ushort regData3 = 0;
            hostComm.WriteRegister(39, regData3);
            hostComm.WriteRegister(16, Convert.ToUInt16(0));
        }
    }
    catch
    {
        MessageBox.Show("InstaTune Not Found!", "Error", (MessageBoxButtons)0);
    }
}


private byte[] MessageExchange(byte[] command)
{
    byte[] array = new byte[4];
    port.Write(command, 0, 4);
    while (port.BytesToRead < 4)
    {
    }
    array[0] = (byte)port.ReadByte();
    array[1] = (byte)port.ReadByte();
    array[2] = (byte)port.ReadByte();
    array[3] = (byte)port.ReadByte();
    return array;
}


private byte[] FormatMessage(byte RegNum, ushort data, bool write)
{
    byte[] array = new byte[4];
    if (write)
    {
        array[0] = (byte)(RegNum | 0x80);
    }
    else
    {
        array[0] = RegNum;
    }
    array[1] = (byte)(data >> 8); 
    array[2] = (byte)data;
    array[3] = 0;
    return array;
}

public void WriteRegister(byte RegNum, ushort RegData)
{
    MessageExchange(FormatMessage(RegNum, RegData, write: true));
}
